pattern.description: Clicking 'Delight users' checks it, moves it to a selected group at the top of the dropdown, re-orders the other options below a divider, and drops a '1 item' chip into the focused Goal field; the cursor then leaves the menu.
pattern.why_premium: One click produces several coordinated state changes (checkbox, re-order, chip, focus ring) on the same frame, showing value instantly; the narration ('just like this') lands on the click.

build_hint.gsap: On click: tl.set('.opt-delight', {checked: true}).add(Flip-style re-order: record option positions, move .opt-delight to the selected group, animate others from old y with duration 0 (instant) or 0.12 power2.out).set('.goal-field', {className: '+=is-focused'}).fromTo('.chip-1-item', {scale: 0.9, autoAlpha: 0}, {scale: 1, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.08, ease: 'power2.out'}); then cursor to(..., {x: 500, y: 233, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Switch the dropdown to its selected state on the click frame (no interpolation, matching the source); optionally spring the chip in with {damping: 30, stiffness: 300, mass: 1} (no overshoot); interpolate cursor position over ~9 frames with Easing.out(Easing.quad).

notes: Nearly all change happens in one frame (f306->f307), i.e. a UI state swap rather than a tween; chip_append chosen for the '1 item' chip, but the list re-order could also be read as layout_reframe. No SFX candidates.
